product.title: Cortech Endurance Sync Durable Wedge Chair - 274
product.body_html:
The Cortech Endurance Sync Wedge is a Modular Angle Chair that is a versatile, spacious chair intended for lounging and group seating. The Sync Chair can stand alone or be combined with any ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chair to create flexible arrangements that allow for change over time. The ergonomic design provides maximum comfort using rotational molding technology. Like the rest of Cortech's Endurance Series Furniture line, the Cortech 'In Sync' Chair is ideal for continuous use in extreme environments, including compassionate and normative Behavioral Health Care Facilities, Residential Treatment Centers and Facilities, Hospital Psychiatric Units, Correctional Institutions, Mental Health Treatment Centers and other medical and public safety facilities that require the ultimate combination of durability and functional design.

  • Durable, one piece, rotationally molded design for increased strength. Constructed of high impact “no break” polyethylene and infused with CORx antimicrobial compound
  • Can be "ganged" or bolted together with Sync Wedge Chair, Sync Chair, and/or Sync Slim Chair
  • Dimensions: 33" H x 31" W x 32" D, Seat Height 19"
  • Integral plinth base for stability and floor mounting integrity
  • Raised edge for easy clean up
  • Sound dampening
  • Easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
  • Can be bolted to the floor via concealed pilot holes (with hardware of your choice)
  • 1500 lb. Static Load, ANSI/BIFMA X5.1-2011
  • Available models:
    • 274 - Sync Wedge Chair without Access Door
    • 274S - Sync Wedge Chair with Access Door for filling with sand ballast (not included) on site
  • Green Guard Gold Certified
  • Passes Flammability UL 94 HB
  • Flame Retardant (passes Cal 133)
  • Tested to ISO 22196 showing >99% reduction in surface bacteria
  • Manufactured to ISO Quality Standards in the USA
  • 10 Year Factory Warranty
  • Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Sand, Slate Blue, Stone Gray
  • Made in the USA.

About Cortech Endurance Furniture:
The Cortech Endurance intense use furniture line is ideal for use as behavioral health furniture, correctional facility furniture, detention furniture, and Behavioral Healthcare mental health furniture. The Endurance Furniture Series is also a perfect fit for residential institutions, public safety facilities, detention centers, correctional institutions, prisons and any intense or high abuse applications such as drug and alcohol rehabilitation centers and addiction treatment centers.

About Cortech USA:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
